title: Show the planner and critic recurring failure classes in their briefs
summary: Add a "Recurring failure classes" section to the planner and critic briefs, built from the introspections and the class registry in records/ (which the snapshot omits). It lists each class seen in at least 3 distinct jobs with title, count and the prevention the introspections proposed, capped to fit the budgets. The audience is the planner and critic models, who can then avoid or catch repeat plan flaws.

defaults_applied.how: Fixture-based unit tests for the new section, plus cargo test and clippy clean.
Criteria check the listed and omitted classes in rendered briefs, not that fields exist.
Behavior criteria name the cargo commands the verifier can run.
Fixtures are invented; no real records, emails or personal data are copied.
One focused change to briefs, the call sites and the changelog.
The briefs get the records data directly, rather than putting records/ in the snapshot.
Doc comments explain the section for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Introspections are athena.introspection/1 records under records/introspections; the CaseRow in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs does not carry the prevention yet, so it is likely extended (or the records re-read) to get it.
Count means the number of introspection cases in the class; the threshold is at least 3 distinct jobs.
Prevention text for a class is taken from its most recent case that proposed one; classes with no proposed prevention are listed with 'none proposed'.
The 'budgets' are the existing per-role budget checks (athena-cli budgets test); the cap on the new section is a fixed constant in briefs.rs sized so these still pass.
Ordering: most cases first, then class id, for determinism.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs, run with `cargo test -p athena-context`, builds fixture class summaries: one class in 3+ distinct jobs, one with many cases in only 2 jobs. It asserts the planner brief and the critic brief both list the qualifying class with its title, count and proposed prevention, and omit the 2-job class.
The test asserts the count is of cases (records) while the threshold counts distinct jobs: a class with 5 cases in 2 jobs is left out, a class with 3 cases in 3 jobs is listed.

A test shows the section is capped: with many qualifying classes, the output keeps the most frequent first, stays within a fixed limit and says how many were left out. With no qualifying classes the section is absent or says none, not an empty heading.
`cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets` passes, so the planner and critic budgets still pass and docs/system-facts.md budget lines match the computed ones.

crates/athena-core/src/run.rs reads the introspections and class registry from the real records/ (not the snapshot) and passes the summaries in PlannerInputs and CriticInputs at the planner_brief and critic_brief call sites; the prevention text is carried from the introspection record, and quoted as data, not instructions.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry saying the planner and critic briefs now carry recurring failure classes (seen in at least 3 distinct jobs), with the cap.

out_of_scope: Putting records/ into the planner or critic snapshot
Changing how introspections classify failures or the class registry
Showing classes to the reader, producer or verifier briefs
departures: Slightly higher cost than reference: the change spans the context and core crates, needs the prevention field plumbed from records, and must stay within budget tests.
